STATEMENT OF COMPLIANCE

These unconsolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the approved

accountin$ standards as applicable in Pakistan; Approved accounting standards comprise of such
lnternational Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) issued by lnternationil Accounting Standards Board
as are notifled under the companies oroinance,'1ei;, pi"'riri";. ;rr"J

3.

BASIS OF PREPARATION
These financiat statements have been prepared under the historicdl cost convention.

The prepQration of financial statements in conformity with the approved Accounting and Financral

Reporting Standards for Small-Sized Entities (SSE) issued by the Institute of ChartereJ Accountants of
Pakistan require management to make judgments, estimates and assumptions that affect the applrcation

of policies and reported amount of assets and liabilities, income and expenses. The estimates and

associated assumptions are based on historical experience and various other factors that are believed to

be reasonable under the circumstances, the results of which form the basis of making the judgments
about carrying values of assets ano tiaoitities th;i ;r; noi r"ro,iv ,;;r..t ;r;, oi;;;r;rr""s. Actuat
results may differ from these estimates. Revision to accounting estimates are recognized prospeciively
commencing from the period of revision.

t'a--

4.

SIGNIF!CANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES

4.1

Propefi, plant and equipment
Depreciation on fixed assets is charged on reducing balance method at the rates specified in the
schedule of fixed assets. Depreciation is provided on aisets for the proportionate period of its use in the
month of addition and disposal. However, depreciation on capitalization of major project cost is charged
to income according to its proportionate period of use. However, normal ,upriru'and maintenance are
charged to income, while major renewals and improvements are capitalized.
Gain and loss on disposal of fixed assets are included in other income.
